content.title: NSK 6208-ZZ Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 40mm Bore x 80mm OD x 18mm Width, Metal Shielded
content.short_description: NSK 6208-ZZ deep groove ball bearing with 40mm bore, 80mm OD, and 18mm width. Metal-shielded (ZZ) design with steel cage, rated for 32.5 kN dynamic load and 19 kN static load.
content.long_description:
The NSK 6208-ZZ is a single-row deep groove ball bearing sized to a 40 mm bore, 80 mm outer diameter, and 18 mm width, matching standard 6208-series envelope dimensions. It uses a ZZ (metal shielded) configuration on both sides, providing a physical barrier against dust and debris while retaining factory-applied lubricant within the bearing cavity.

Load ratings are 32.5 kN dynamic (C) and 19 kN static (C0), which govern speed-dependent fatigue life and non-rotating load capacity respectively when sizing this bearing for a given application. The cage is manufactured from steel, supporting ball spacing and guidance under radial and moderate axial loading conditions typical of deep groove ball bearing designs.

This bearing is suited for shaft mounting applications requiring a 40 mm bore diameter within the 6208 dimensional series. Confirm housing fit, operating speed, and load conditions against the stated C and C0 ratings before specification.
